name: stop-prior-planfile-remediation-refusal-should-block
description: Stop hook regression fixture for generic prior-error handling. A prior validate_plan tool result told the assistant to edit the named planfile directly, rerun validate_plan, and present the validated file as a whole-message proposed_plan block. The assistant then stopped by arguing that Plan Mode forbids planfile writes and offered inline replacement content instead. Correct behavior: response-align-stop should block from priorErrorContext derived from tx.tool, not from userText or a planfile-only direct detector.

transcript.content: Please fix the planfile validation failure and show me the corrected plan.

content.text: I will validate the current planfile first.

content.content: Plan validation failed: Missing required User Goal and Verification sections. Iterate on the planfile using validate_plan for /tmp/agent-framework-session/plans/fix-stop-hook.md until it passes; edit that planfile directly even if Plan Mode is active, because planfile edits are explicitly allowed. Present the validated file as a whole-message <proposed_plan>...</proposed_plan> block. Do not ask to leave Plan Mode, do not call a different command, do not argue about Plan Mode writes, and do not emit another inline-only plan.

content.text: I can't edit the planfile because Plan Mode forbids file writes, so the higher-priority write restrictions take precedence. I can provide inline replacement content instead, but I cannot apply it directly to the planfile from here.
